# Azure Cost & Compliance Monitor (Lab)
---
Synthetic cost and compliance data; anomalies calculated from resource-day baselines, not planted labels.

content.query:
let DailyTotals = materialize(
    AzureResourceCost_CL
    | extend Day=startofday(todatetime(column_ifexists("Date_s", column_ifexists("Date", "")))),
             ResourceName=tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceName_s", column_ifexists("ResourceName", ""))),
             ResourceType=tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceType_s", column_ifexists("ResourceType", ""))),
             ResourceGroupName=tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceGroup_s", column_ifexists("ResourceGroup", ""))),
             Cost=todouble(column_ifexists("DailyCost_d", column_ifexists("DailyCost", real(null))))
    | where Day between (startofday(ago(30d)) .. startofday(now())) and isnotnull(Cost)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Cost) by Day, ResourceGroupName, ResourceType, ResourceName
    | summarize TotalDailyCost=sum(Cost) by Day
);
let AvgObservedDayCost=toscalar(DailyTotals | summarize avg(TotalDailyCost));
DailyTotals
| extend Baseline=round(AvgObservedDayCost,2),
         PercentageVsBaseline=iff(AvgObservedDayCost>0,
              round(100.0*(TotalDailyCost-AvgObservedDayCost)/AvgObservedDayCost,2), real(null))
| project Day, TotalDailyCost=round(TotalDailyCost,2), Baseline, PercentageVsBaseline
| order by Day asc
content.title: 30 Day Spend Trend

content.query:
// This lab generator emits one cost record per resource and event day.
// arg_max deduplicates repeated uploads of those same synthetic records.
// Historical query: includes the planted test spike without reading IsAnomaly_b.
let CostThresholdPct = 30.0;
let CostThresholdAbs = 10.0;
let DailyResourceSpend = materialize(
    AzureResourceCost_CL
    | extend Day=startofday(todatetime(column_ifexists("Date_s", column_ifexists("Date", "")))),
             ResourceName=tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceName_s", column_ifexists("ResourceName", ""))),
             ResourceType=tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceType_s", column_ifexists("ResourceType", ""))),
             ResourceGroupName=tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceGroup_s", column_ifexists("ResourceGroup", ""))),
             Cost=todouble(column_ifexists("DailyCost_d", column_ifexists("DailyCost", real(null))))
    | where isnotnull(Day) and isnotnull(Cost) and isnotempty(ResourceName)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Cost) by ResourceGroupName, ResourceType, ResourceName, Day
    | project ResourceGroupName, ResourceType, ResourceName, Day, DailySpend=Cost
);
let PriorResourceDays = DailyResourceSpend
    | project ResourceGroupName, ResourceType, ResourceName,
              PreviousDay=Day, PreviousSpend=DailySpend;
DailyResourceSpend
| join kind=inner PriorResourceDays on ResourceGroupName, ResourceType, ResourceName
| where PreviousDay >= Day-29d and PreviousDay < Day
| summarize BaselineDays=count(), AvgDailyResourceCost=avg(PreviousSpend),
            StdDevDailyCost=stdev(PreviousSpend)
    by ResourceGroupName, ResourceType, ResourceName, Day, DailySpend
| where BaselineDays >= 7 and AvgDailyResourceCost > 0
| extend CostIncrease = DailySpend - AvgDailyResourceCost
| extend PercentageIncrease = 100.0 * CostIncrease / AvgDailyResourceCost
| where CostIncrease > CostThresholdAbs and PercentageIncrease > CostThresholdPct
| extend DeviationsFromNormal=iff(StdDevDailyCost > 0.0,
                                  CostIncrease/StdDevDailyCost, real(null))
| project Day, ResourceGroupName, ResourceName, ResourceType,
          TodayCost=round(DailySpend,2),
          AvgDailyResourceCost=round(AvgDailyResourceCost,2),
          CostIncrease=round(CostIncrease,2),
          PercentageIncrease=round(PercentageIncrease,2),
          DeviationsFromNormal=round(DeviationsFromNormal,2), BaselineDays
| order by Day desc, CostIncrease desc
content.title: Historical Cost Anomalies Detected

content.query:
let ResourceDays =
    AzureResourceCost_CL
    | extend Day=startofday(todatetime(column_ifexists("Date_s", column_ifexists("Date", "")))),
             ResourceName=tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceName_s", column_ifexists("ResourceName", ""))),
             ResourceType=tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceType_s", column_ifexists("ResourceType", ""))),
             ResourceGroupName=tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceGroup_s", column_ifexists("ResourceGroup", ""))),
             Cost=todouble(column_ifexists("DailyCost_d", column_ifexists("DailyCost", real(null))))
    | where Day between (startofday(ago(30d)) .. startofday(now())) and isnotnull(Cost)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Cost) by ResourceName, ResourceType, ResourceGroupName, Day
    | project ResourceName, ResourceType, ResourceGroupName, Day, DailySpend=Cost;
ResourceDays
| summarize TotalCost=round(sum(DailySpend),2),
            AvgDailyCost=round(avg(DailySpend),2),
            MaxDailyCost=round(max(DailySpend),2), DaysActive=count()
    by ResourceName, ResourceType, ResourceGroupName
| extend MonthlyCostProjection=round(AvgDailyCost*30.0,2)
| extend CostRating=case(AvgDailyCost>50.0,"High",
                         AvgDailyCost>20.0,"Medium","Low")
| project ResourceGroupName, ResourceName, ResourceType, TotalCost,
          AvgDailyCost, MaxDailyCost, MonthlyCostProjection, DaysActive, CostRating
| order by TotalCost desc
content.title: Top Spending Resources

content.query:
// Synthetic test records: one check per device, policy, and event day.
// Deduplicate uploads; use the generator's Date rather than ingestion timestamp.
let Checks = materialize(
    IntuneDeviceCompliance_CL
    | extend Day=startofday(todatetime(column_ifexists("Date", column_ifexists("Date_s", "")))),
             DeviceName=tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", column_ifexists("DeviceName_s", ""))),
             PolicyName=tostring(column_ifexists("PolicyName", column_ifexists("PolicyName_s", ""))),
             Department=tostring(column_ifexists("Department", column_ifexists("Department_s", ""))),
             OperatingSystem=tostring(column_ifexists("OperatingSystem", column_ifexists("OperatingSystem_s", ""))),
             UserName=tostring(column_ifexists("UserName", column_ifexists("UserName_s", ""))),
             Compliant=tobool(column_ifexists("IsCompliant", column_ifexists("IsCompliant_b", bool(null)))),
             Drift=tobool(column_ifexists("IsComplianceDrift", column_ifexists("IsComplianceDrift_b", bool(null))))
    | where Day between (startofday(ago(30d)) .. startofday(now()))
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Day, DeviceName, PolicyName
);
Checks
| summarize TotalChecks=count(), CompliantChecks=countif(Compliant == true),
            NonCompliantChecks=countif(Compliant == false) by Day
| extend ComplianceRate=round(100.0*todouble(CompliantChecks)/TotalChecks,2)
| project Day, TotalChecks, CompliantChecks, NonCompliantChecks, ComplianceRate
| order by Day asc
content.title: 30 Day Compliance Rate Trend

// Synthetic test records: one check per device, policy, and event day.
// Deduplicate uploads; use the generator's Date rather than ingestion timestamp.
let Checks = materialize(
    IntuneDeviceCompliance_CL
    | extend Day=startofday(todatetime(column_ifexists("Date", column_ifexists("Date_s", "")))),
             DeviceName=tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", column_ifexists("DeviceName_s", ""))),
             PolicyName=tostring(column_ifexists("PolicyName", column_ifexists("PolicyName_s", ""))),
             Department=tostring(column_ifexists("Department", column_ifexists("Department_s", ""))),
             OperatingSystem=tostring(column_ifexists("OperatingSystem", column_ifexists("OperatingSystem_s", ""))),
             UserName=tostring(column_ifexists("UserName", column_ifexists("UserName_s", ""))),
             Compliant=tobool(column_ifexists("IsCompliant", column_ifexists("IsCompliant_b", bool(null)))),
             Drift=tobool(column_ifexists("IsComplianceDrift", column_ifexists("IsComplianceDrift_b", bool(null))))
    | where Day between (startofday(ago(30d)) .. startofday(now()))
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Day, DeviceName, PolicyName
);
Checks
| where Drift == true
| summarize DriftCount=count(), AffectedDevices=make_set(DeviceName,50),
            AffectedUsers=make_set(UserName,50)
    by Day, Department, PolicyName
| project Day, Department, PolicyName, DriftCount, AffectedDevices, AffectedUsers
| order by Day desc
content.title: Synthetic Compliance Drift Events
